title: Genesis 6:14 — kopher, the Hebrew word for pitch
summary: Genesis 6:13-14 in English and Hebrew with the Hebrew word כפר (kopher) highlighted in the last word of the verse and defined as 'Pitch'; the word ark is partly red in the English.

text.text: 13 Then God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before Me; for the earth is filled with violence because of them; and behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.
14 “Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; you shall make the ark with rooms, and shall cover it inside and out with pitch.
14 עשה לך תבת עצי־גפר קנים תעשה את־התבה וכפרת אתה מבית ומחוץ בכפר

refs.shown: Genesis 6:13 (verse 13 text shown under the Genesis 6:14 heading)
